adjudication.rationale: In the new `refreshOAuthTokens` helper (`packages/app-store/_utils/oauth/refreshOAuthTokens.ts`), when `APP_CREDENTIAL_SHARING_ENABLED && CALCOM_CREDENTIAL_SYNC_ENDPOINT && userId` it performs a `fetch(...)` and returns the raw `Response` object (it does not call `.json()`). In `packages/app-store/hubspot/lib/CalendarService.ts`, the code assigns the result of `refreshOAuthTokens(...)` to `hubspotRefreshToken: HubspotToken`, but under sync-mode that value will actually be a `Response`, not a HubSpot token object. That makes downstream access to token fields (e.g., expiry/refresh token properties) incorrect at runtime when the sync endpoint is enabled.
